# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Prefer simpler, unified design approaches over multiple similar code paths, and favor user-facing options over hidden complexity.
- When suggesting improvements, present them first for a decision rather than implementing them automatically.
- Self-audit code changes and validate with a build before completion.
- Prefer unified shared logic over separate code paths for related features, and favor an intuitive slider without a redundant “Spacing” label in the Rebar property menu.
